name: atmosphere-mcp-bridge
description: Connects Claude Desktop to an Atmosphere MCP server over Streamable HTTP, including one on localhost or a private network.
long_description: A native build of Atmosphere's stdio bridge (org.atmosphere.mcp.bridge.McpStdioBridge). Claude Desktop starts it and talks MCP over stdio; the bridge forwards each message to the configured Atmosphere endpoint over Streamable HTTP and relays responses, server notifications and server-initiated requests (elicitation, sampling, roots) back. Because it runs on your machine, it reaches servers that Anthropic's cloud cannot, such as http://localhost. No Java installation is needed.

endpoint.title: MCP endpoint URL
endpoint.description: The Atmosphere MCP endpoint, for example http://localhost:8080/atmosphere/mcp

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: Sent as Authorization: Bearer when the endpoint requires authentication. Leave empty otherwise.

timeout.title: Response timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long to wait for a response's headers. 0 waits as long as the call takes.
